references.text: The original instruction for the design of the menorah, with four almond-shaped cups, knobs and flowers, as Exodus 37:20 describes its execution.
The entire passage containing God's instructions to Moses on how the lampstand was to be made, which the craftsman Bezalel completed in Exodus 37.
The complete description of the making of the golden lampstand, where verse 20 is part of this detailed account.
Description of the lampstand's design with floral decorations, confirming the same design that was carried out in Exodus 37:20.
Solomon's temple had ten golden lampstands made according to the pattern of the tabernacle's menorah.
The book of Hebrews mentions the lampstand as part of the holy place in the tabernacle, pointing back to its making in Exodus.
John sees seven golden lampstands in his vision, which symbolically connect to the tabernacle's menorah.
Complementary detailed description of the lampstand's arms that expands on the image from 37:20.
Complementary detail explaining how the arms were attached to the main stem mentioned in 37:20.
The actual completion and consecration of the lampstand described in 37:20.
